# wso2is_group (Resource)

Manages a group of users. Manage the members with `wso2is_group_members`, and the roles with `wso2is_role_assignment`. By default, the server requires group names to be 3 to 30 characters long, without spaces. To import a group, use its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, without the user store prefix.

### Optional

- `user_store` (String) User store domain. The default is `PRIMARY`. Changing it replaces the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_group.developers <group_id>
```
